verdict.rationale: Multi-protocol serving is a fair question for a cloud app platform, but the evidence pack never documents TCP, gRPC, or WebSocket support, or serving several protocols from one service without separate configuration. The only related items are a global Anycast network and an HTTPS URL per Sprite. Neither shows the multi-protocol capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve HTTP, TCP, gRPC, and WebSocket traffic from the same deployed service without separate protocol configuration
